# Sample size calculation for proportion estimation
# Two-sided 95% CI, target proportion p = 0.70, half-width (margin of error) = 0.03
# Using normal approximation with z = 1.96 (exact 97.5th percentile)

p <- 0.70           # Target proportion
q <- 1 - p          # Complement
z_critical <- 1.96  # Standard normal 97.5th percentile (two-sided 95% CI: alpha/2 = 0.025)
margin_of_error <- 0.03  # Half-width of confidence interval

# Formula: n = (z^2 * p * q) / ME^2
n_exact <- (z_critical^2 * p * q) / (margin_of_error^2)

print(paste("Exact sample size (before rounding):", round(n_exact, 6)))
print(paste("Variance term (p*q):", p * q))
print(paste("Numerator (z^2 * p * q):", z_critical^2 * p * q))
print(paste("Denominator (ME^2):", margin_of_error^2))

# Round upward to nearest integer
n_rounded <- ceiling(n_exact)

print(paste("Sample size (rounded upward):", n_rounded))

# Store result for output
result <- list(
  sample_size = n_rounded,
  n_exact = n_exact,
  parameters = list(
    p = p,
    q = q,
    z_critical = z_critical,
    margin_of_error = margin_of_error
  )
)

# Verification: compute the achieved half-width with the rounded sample size
achieved_half_width <- z_critical * sqrt((p * q) / n_rounded)
print(paste("Achieved half-width with n =", n_rounded, ":", round(achieved_half_width, 6)))
print(paste("Target half-width:", margin_of_error))
